subject: Confidence intervals for QTL effect in fitqtl

messages.author: 5d97d4390632d102
messages.subject: Confidence intervals for QTL effect in fitqtl
parts:
Hi,
I have identified QTL from a scan and put them in the "fitqtl" function, which I
assume is simply a general linear model. Is there a direct way to obtain 95%
confidence interval for the parameter that estimates the QTL effect? Or
alternatively, is there a way to get a hold of the standard errors for the
parameter? Thanks for your help.
Frank.

messages.author: f388084a0de67b60
messages.subject: Re: Confidence intervals for QTL effect in fitqtl
parts:
fitqtl() now can give estimated effects and standard errors; use
get.ests=TRUE.

karl
